# libsamplerate

This directory contains the minimal build inputs from libsamplerate 0.2.2,
upstream commit `c96f5e3de9c4488f4e6c97f59f5245f22fda22f7`.

Upstream: https://github.com/libsndfile/libsamplerate

The vendored files are built as a private static dependency. Examples,
upstream tests, installation rules, package metadata, and repository history
are intentionally excluded. The original BSD license is preserved in
`COPYING`.
